brand.name: Maya Okafor Coaching
brand.tagline: Executive coaching for senior product leaders.

hero.lede: I work with VPs of Product, Heads of Design, and founder-CEOs through six-month coaching engagements. Evidence-based, deeply confidential, and structured around the questions you actually can't bring into the room.

approach.headline: Coaching that compounds, not therapy dressed up as strategy.

items.title: One real question per session
items.body: Each conversation starts from a single question you bring in. We sit with it. We don't triage.

items.title: Evidence over vibes
items.body: Every framework I use has academic grounding — adult development, immunity-to-change, polarity mapping. No proprietary acronyms.

items.title: Confidential, on the record
items.body: Sessions are private. Notes are yours. I don't carry your context into other rooms or share patterns with your employer.

items.title: Practice, not performance
items.body: The point isn't the session — it's the four hundred hours between sessions. Small experiments, run in the wild.

items.title: The full container
items.body: The default engagement. Twenty-six 75-minute sessions, weekly, with two review checkpoints. Best for leaders inside a real transition.

items.title: The focused container
items.body: For a specific question with a specific deadline — a launch, a restructure, a high-stakes negotiation. Twelve sessions, designed to close cleanly.

items.title: The single session
items.body: Single 90-minute deep-dive for past clients only. Bring one stuck question. You leave with one experiment and a written summary inside 48 hours.

paragraphs: I spent twelve years inside product organisations — most recently as VP of Product at Helio, before that leading design at two Series-B startups. I've hired, fired, restructured, and been restructured.
I trained at the Co-Active Training Institute, hold the PCC credential from the International Coaching Federation, and continue weekly supervision with a senior coach.
I'm based in Lisbon. I work in English and (slowly) Portuguese.

facts.value: Stripe · Notion · Linear · Vercel · Pitch · Figma alumni

facts.value: 2 places held for first-time founders of colour

contact.lede: The discovery call exists for both of us. You describe what you're sitting with; I tell you whether I'm the right coach for it. About a third of the time I'm not, and I'll point you at someone better.
contact.footnote: I respond inside two working days. Lisbon time, GMT+0.
